items.title: Papers: Arsenal hold further talks over Villa's Konsa
items.description: The top stories and transfer rumours from Thursday's newspapers...

items.title: Chawinga sisters fire Malawi into Wafcon final
items.description: Malawi's fairy tale run at the 2026 Women's Africa Cup of Nations goes on as sisters Tabitha and Temwa Chawinga share three goals in a 3-1 semi-final win over Algeria.

items.title: Chawinga sisters fire Malawi into Wafcon final
items.description: Malawi's fairy tale run at the 2026 Women's Africa Cup of Nations goes on as sisters Tabitha and Temwa Chawinga share three goals in a 3-1 semi-final win over Algeria.

items.title: Fearless Madjo, 17, ends eight-month wait with dream Villa debut
items.description: Teenage striker Brian Madjo scores on his Aston Villa debut in Uefa Super Cup defeat by Paris St-Germain to end eight-month wait for a chance to play in competitive games.

items.title: Arteta: There's more we want to do in the transfer market
items.description: Mikel Arteta says Arsenal are actively looking for more new signings in the transfer market but admits there is only a small pool of available players who can take them to the next level.

items.title: How 'hugely impressive' Villa teen Madjo took fight to PSG
items.description: Match of the Day's Nedum Onuoha and Stephen Warnock analyse 17-year-old Brian Madjo's "hugely impressive" goalscoring performance for Aston Villa in their 2-1 defeat by PSG in the UEFA Super Cup.

items.title: Lukaku seals 'emotional' move to Fenerbahce
items.description: Belgium striker Romelu Lukaku has joined Turkish side Fenerbahce from Napoli for an undisclosed fee and contract length.

items.title: Hull sign central defenders Mendy and Herrington
items.description: Hull City confirm the signing of Nobel Mendy from Rayo Vallecano for a club record fee, while they also add fellow centre-back Lucas Herrington from Colorado Rapids.

items.title: Galatasaray submit Martinelli bid - Thursday's gossip
items.description: Arsenal have received a bid from Galatasaray for Gabriel Martinelli, Spain midfielder Martin Zubimendi could leave the Gunners for Chelsea and Newcastle push for Benfica defender Amar Dedic.

items.title: MI London's Hundred title defence over despite narrow win over Phoenix
items.description: MI London had the lights turned out on their hopes of claiming a fourth straight Hundred title despite beating bottom-placed Birmingham Phoenix in a nip-and-tuck final men's group match.

items.title: Doue silences Madjo-mania as PSG beat Villa to win Super Cup
items.description: Desire Doue scored the winner as champions of Europe Paris Saint-Germain beat Aston Villa 2-1 to win the UEFA Super Cup.

items.title: Chelsea set Friday deadline over £120m Fernandez
items.description: Chelsea set a Friday deadline for offers of £120m for clubs interested in midfielder Enzo Fernandez.
